ja: • ジバニャンが全高約220mmの超大型プラモになって登場。
• ブロック感覚でパチパチ組めるうえ、設定色も完全再現。初めてのプラモとしても楽しめる。
• 目は回転式。くるくる回すだけで表情の変化を楽しめる。目の種類は4パターン。
• 口は引き出し式。ジバニャンの表情を豊かに変える。
• 腕には関節が入り、首や腰も可動するので、細かなポージングが可能。
• しっぽはボールジョイントを使用し、ゆらゆらしっぽを再現できる。
• 通常のジバニャン（別売り）と同サイズ 全高約10cmのウィスパーも付属。
• 全高約10cmサイズの ジバニャン（別売り）やウィスパーを頭部に乗せられるギミックも搭載。
成形品×8、シール×１、組立説明書×１
en: • Jibanyan is now available as a super large plastic model with a total height of approximately 220mm.
• You can assemble it like a block, and the set colors are also perfectly reproduced. You can also enjoy it as your first plastic model.
• Eyes are rotating. You can enjoy changing facial expressions just by spinning it around. There are 4 types of eyes.
• The mouth is a pull-out type. Jibanyan's expression changes richly.
• The arms have joints, and the neck and waist can also move, allowing for detailed poses.
• The tail uses a ball joint, allowing you to recreate the swaying tail.
• Also included is Whisper, which is the same size as regular Jibanyan (sold separately) and has a total height of approximately 10cm.
• Equipped with a gimmick that allows Jibanyan (sold separately) and Whisper, which are approximately 10cm tall, to be placed on the head.
Molded product x 8, Seal x 1, Assembly manual x 1
